d: Very long, straight jet black hair flows down the back with a sharp, singular cowlick at the crown. A red glowing rose-shaped visor obscures the eyes, paired with a youthful, mature facial appearance. The build is slender and athletic, clad in a black futuristic bodysuit featuring a red-accented armored chest piece, detached sleeve-armor, and high-heeled armored boots with glowing red circular accents. The outfit includes sheer black thigh-high stockings with a "09" marking on the left thigh and a long black katana with a glowing red edge.
